Available at {{brand}}

FineXel
Fractional CO2 laser.

Our FineXel device is used for fractional CO2 laser treatments. The laser treats small points of skin, leaving skin between them untreated. This approach is used for skin resurfacing.

Before a session, we assess your skin, discuss what you want to improve and explain the recovery time. Watch the video for a closer look at the device during treatment.

Fractional CO2Skin resurfacingAssessment comes first
Ask about FineXel
01 / Texture

Texture & fine lines

Fractional CO2 resurfacing may help improve uneven texture and some fine lines. The result and recovery depend on your skin, the area and treatment settings.

02 / Scars

Acne scars

Some acne scars may be treated with fractional CO2 laser. We assess the type and depth of scarring before discussing whether laser or another option is suitable.

03 / Recovery

Time to heal

Redness, swelling and peeling can follow treatment, and downtime varies. We explain cleansing, moisturising and sun protection, along with when to contact the clinic.

Before your visit

FineXel, explained.

Does {{brand}} have a FineXel device?

Yes. The video shows our FineXel fractional CO2 laser at {{brand}}. Contact us to confirm the branch and arrange a consultation.

What is fractional CO2 laser?

It is a skin resurfacing treatment that applies CO2 laser energy to small areas in a pattern, leaving skin between them untreated. The treatment settings are chosen after a medical assessment.

What can fractional CO2 laser help with?

It may be considered for certain acne scars, uneven texture and fine lines. Suitability depends on the concern and your skin. Results vary, and more than one session may be needed.

How much recovery time will I need?

Recovery depends on the treatment depth, area and your skin. Redness, swelling, peeling and sensitivity can last for several days, with redness sometimes lasting longer. We will discuss timing and aftercare before you book.

Is fractional CO2 laser suitable for everyone?

No. We review your skin tone, healing history, medicines and recent procedures. Tell us about active skin infections, cold sores, pregnancy and recent tanning. We will explain possible risks, including pigment changes and scarring, and whether another approach would suit you.

How many FineXel sessions will I need?

There is no single course for everyone. We suggest a plan after assessing your skin and goals, then review your response before recommending further sessions.

How much does fractional CO2 laser cost in Cairo?

Cost depends on the area and the session plan agreed after assessment. Ask the branch on WhatsApp for a quote and discuss your plan before booking.
